inputs.prompt: ONE original heavy infantry soldier, the Gateward Phalanx, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the closed bronze face helmet with a tall red fan crest, weathered dark bronze and steel scale and plate armour with riveted shoulder plates, burgundy tunic skirt and burgundy cape, bronze greaves and dark boots. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-LEFT hand holds ONE long dark wooden pike with a three-pronged steel head; the screen-RIGHT forearm carries ONE tall narrow rectangular shield with pointed ends, a brass border and a round brass boss, held in front of the body. Preserve the pike length, the three-pronged head, the shield size and markings, the armour, the crest and adult proportions. Make ONE powerful pike thrust toward screen right. Swing the pike down from upright until it is level at the hip with the three-pronged head pointing at screen right, step forward with the front leg and drive the pike straight out to full reach beside the shield, then draw it back and raise it upright into the original ready stance. One thrust only; the shield stays on the screen-right forearm in front of the body. No throw, no second strike. Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full crest, pike, shield, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, magic, glow, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the equipment.
